about: Held-out set. None of this was used to choose keywords, thresholds or prompts. The scam messages are longer and quieter than the tuning corpus; the ordinary pages are real public pages, fetched live when the test runs (only their addresses are stored here). Every name, number and company in the scam messages is invented. Round one exposed a gate that was too narrow, and the gate was redesigned (src/inference/shape.ts). Round two was written after that redesign. Its first run caught 6 of 6; a false alarm on a real page in that same run then led to one more change (pages that are about scams), after which round two was still 6 of 6. A third group of real pages (banks, payment, sign-in and account pages) was added on 15 Nov after an outside review asked for genuine transactional pages.

scams.text: Grandma it's me. Please don't be mad and please don't tell Mom or Dad yet. I was in a car accident last night on the way back from a friend's place. Nobody is badly hurt but the other driver is pressing charges and I spent the night at the county holding facility. My public defender, Mr. Alan Brooks, says the judge will release me this afternoon if bail is posted before 3 o'clock, otherwise I stay here over the weekend. It is $4,800. He said the fastest way is for you to withdraw cash and a courier from the bond office will collect it from your house in a sealed envelope, or you can pay it with prepaid cards and read him the numbers over the phone. Please call him directly on 1-855-555-0133, he is expecting you. If the bank teller asks, just say it is for home repairs, they sometimes hold large withdrawals and I can't wait. I'm so sorry. I love you and I'll pay you back every cent, I promise. Please hurry.

Riverside Power & Light: Disconnection Notice. Service address on file. Our records show two missed payments on your residential electric account and a past-due balance of $612.47. A field technician has been scheduled to disconnect service at this address today between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM. Once the meter is removed a reconnection fee of $350 and a new security deposit will apply, and reconnection can take up to five business days. To stop the disconnection you must speak with our billing department before the technician arrives. Call 1-855-555-0171 now and have your payment ready. Because your account is flagged, we can no longer accept personal checks or card payments from this address. Payment must be made by MoneyPak, Green Dot or another prepaid voucher available at most pharmacies and grocery stores; the agent will give you the amount and take the numbers from the back of the voucher while you remain on the line. Do not send payment by mail. This is your final courtesy notice.

Hi, are you at your desk? I'm heading into back-to-back meetings with the board and can't take calls, so email only for the next couple of hours please. I need a quick favour and I need it handled quietly. We are surprising the regional team with a thank-you for the quarter and I promised the gifts would go out today. Can you pick up 8 Apple gift cards at $100 each from the shop near the office? Pay with your own card for now and I'll approve the expense claim tonight, with a little extra for the trouble. Once you have them, scratch the silver panel on the back of each card and send me clear photos of the codes by reply so I can forward them straight to the team. Please don't mention it to anyone in finance or to the others, I want it to stay a surprise until Friday. Let me know the moment it's done. Thanks, I knew I could count on you. Sent from my phone.

Welcome back to your Meridian Wealth Circle dashboard. Your account manager has posted a new message. Good news: the pool you joined last week closed up 31% and your balance now stands at $18,420. As promised, withdrawals are open to members in good standing. Before the release desk can send your funds, compliance requires a one-time liquidity verification equal to 12% of the balance. This is not a fee, it is returned to you with the withdrawal inside 24 hours. Please send $2,210 in USDT to the wallet address your manager gave you in the chat, then upload a screenshot of the transfer here. Members who verify today keep their place in next month's pool, which is limited to forty people and has a guaranteed minimum return of 18%. Please keep the details of the pool inside the circle; banks and family members often misunderstand private placements and can cause delays. If your bank questions the transfer, say it is for a personal purchase. Your manager is online now and can stay on a call with you while you complete it.

Medicare Benefits Update Center. Important: your red, white and blue Medicare card is being replaced with a new chip card and your current card will stop working at the end of this month. To avoid any interruption in your coverage, you must confirm your details so the new card can be mailed. Our records need the following from you today: your Medicare number, your Social Security number, your date of birth and the bank account your premium is paid from, so the processing charge of $9.95 can be collected. A benefits specialist can complete this with you by phone in under five minutes at 1-855-555-0158. Please have your current card and a voided check in front of you. If we do not hear from you within 48 hours your file will be marked inactive and claims from your doctor and pharmacy may be denied. Do not wait for a letter; the replacement programme is being handled by phone only.

Thank you for your order. Invoice INV-88213. Your ShieldGuard Total Protection plan has been renewed for 3 years and $439.99 has been charged to the card on file. The charge will appear on your statement within 24 hours. Order summary: ShieldGuard Total Protection, 5 devices, 36 months, auto-renewal enabled. If you did not authorise this renewal or would like a refund, you must contact our cancellation team within 24 hours of this notice. Refunds cannot be processed by email. Call 1-855-555-0126 and a refund specialist will help you. To issue the refund the specialist will ask you to open a support session so they can fill in the refund form on your computer; please be at your computer and logged in to your online banking so the amount can be returned to the correct account while you are on the call. Thank you for choosing ShieldGuard.

Parcel on hold. We attempted to deliver your package today but it is being held at our customs depot because the import duty has not been paid. Item: 1 parcel, 1.2 kg. Status: awaiting payment. To release your parcel for delivery tomorrow, pay the outstanding customs charge of $2.99 using the secure form below. Parcels not released within 3 days are returned to the sender and a storage charge is applied. Enter the name on your card, your card number, the expiry date and the 3-digit security code. You will then receive a text message with a verification code from your bank; enter that code on the next screen to confirm that you are the cardholder. Thank you for your cooperation.

My darling, I hardly slept. I keep thinking about our plans for when this contract ends and I can finally come home to you. I hate to bring you bad news after such a lovely talk last night. The company has frozen all of our pay until the rig inspection is signed off, and the port agent will not release my equipment or my return ticket until the transit fee is settled. It is $3,600. I would never ask if I had any other way, you know my accounts cannot be reached from here. My friend David at the shipping office says the only thing that clears the same day is a wire, or Bitcoin from one of those machines at the petrol station, he can send you the details. Please don't mention it to your daughter, she already thinks badly of me and I couldn't bear it. I will pay back every penny the week I land, with the ring I promised. Can you go this morning, my love? Tell me when it is done so I can stop worrying.

Fraud Prevention Team. We have stopped three payments leaving your current account in the last hour and we believe a member of staff at your local branch may be involved. For that reason please do not visit or telephone the branch, and do not discuss this with anyone, as it could compromise the investigation. To protect your money we have opened a temporary safe account in your name. You need to move your balance into it today. Our investigator will stay on the line and guide you through the transfer in your online banking; when the app asks for the reason, choose 'paying a friend' so the transfer is not delayed by the security checks. Your funds will be returned to a new account within 48 hours. Call the investigation line now on 1-855-555-0190 and quote the case reference you were given. Acting quickly is the only way to keep your savings safe.

Congratulations! Your email address was drawn in the International Shoppers Reward Programme and you have been awarded a cash prize of $850,000 and a new car. No ticket purchase was necessary. Your winning reference has been passed to our claims agent, who will arrange delivery of your cheque by insured courier. To begin your claim, reply with your full name, home address, telephone number, date of birth and occupation. Winners are required to cover the courier insurance and government clearance charge of $1,450 before the prize is released; this can be paid by wire transfer or gift cards and is refunded with your winnings. For security reasons you are advised to keep this award confidential until your claim has been processed, to avoid double claiming. Claims not started within 7 days are forfeited to the next winner.

scamsRound2.text: County Sheriff's Office, Civil Process Division. This message is to inform you that you failed to appear for federal jury duty on the date in your summons, and a bench warrant has been signed. To avoid being taken into custody you may resolve the citation by posting a refundable bond of $1,900. Deputies cannot accept payment in person. Purchase a prepaid debit voucher at any pharmacy and call Sergeant Mills on 1-855-555-0145 with the voucher numbers. You must remain on the phone until the bond is confirmed. Do not hang up and do not discuss the matter with others, as it is under a gag order.

Congratulations, you have been selected for the Remote Administrative Assistant position. Your starting pay is $780 weekly. To get you set up, our accounts department has mailed you a cashier's check for $3,950 to cover your home office equipment. Deposit the check using your bank's mobile app as soon as it arrives. Keep $450 as your first week's pay and send the remaining $3,500 to our approved equipment vendor the same day by Zelle or by buying gift cards, so your laptop can ship. Please confirm by text once the deposit is made and do not mention the arrangement to the bank teller, as it slows down processing.

State Turnpike Authority: Our records show an unpaid toll of $6.85 on your vehicle. A late charge of $57.00 will be added if the balance is not settled today, and unpaid tolls may be reported to the DMV and result in suspension of your registration. Settle your balance now using the secure form. Enter your full name, home address, card number, expiry date and security code. A verification code will be sent to your phone by your bank; enter it to complete the payment.

Thank you for choosing Willow Creek Puppies. Bella is ready to travel to her new home! Before the carrier can release her we need one more step. The airline requires a temperature-controlled crate and pet travel insurance, a refundable charge of $680 that is returned to you on delivery. Payment must reach us within 3 hours or Bella will miss her flight and a rebooking charge of $250 applies. We can only accept Walmart gift cards, a wire or Cash App for this payment, as our card machine is down. Send the codes by text to 1-855-555-0102 and we will send the tracking number right away.

You sent a payment of $799.99 to Crypto Exchange LLC. Transaction ID 7HK29441. This charge will appear on your statement within 12 hours. If you did not make this purchase, our fraud team can cancel it, but only by telephone and only within the next 6 hours. Call our Resolution Center on 1-855-555-0117. To reverse the payment the agent will connect to your computer with a remote support tool and ask you to sign in to your online banking so the refund can be issued directly.

URGENT APPEAL: Families who lost everything in last week's floods are sleeping in their cars tonight. Our volunteers are on the ground now, but our bank has placed a hold on our account and we cannot access donations for 10 days. That is why we are asking supporters to give today by gift card or cryptocurrency, which reach the families immediately. Buy any amount of Amazon or Visa gift cards and reply to this message with the card numbers and PINs, or send Bitcoin to the wallet in the next message. Please do not use our website donation form, it is not working. Every hour counts.

round3About: Round 3, written on 18 Nov 2026 after all tuning was finished and run once. Nothing was changed after seeing its result. Twelve scams of kinds not in the earlier rounds, and twelve ordinary messages chosen to look like scams on the surface (money, codes, deadlines, phone numbers) while asking for nothing a scammer would.

scamsRound3.text: Social Security Administration, Office of the Inspector General. Your Social Security number has been suspended because it was found at a crime scene in Texas linked to money laundering. To avoid arrest and the freezing of your benefits, you must call our enforcement officer at 1-888-555-0143 today. You will be asked to verify your number and move your savings into a protected government account until the investigation is closed. Do not discuss this case with your bank, as bank staff may be involved.

Amazon Order Confirmation. Thank you for your order of Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max (512 GB), total $1,299.00, shipping to Miami, FL. If you did not place this order, call Amazon Fraud Support immediately at 1-844-555-0177 to cancel it and receive a full refund. A technician will help you install a secure support session on your computer to remove the unauthorized charge. Orders not disputed within 2 hours will be shipped and charged.

This is Agent Daniel Brooks from your bank's fraud team. Hackers have accessed your checking and savings accounts and are moving money right now. To protect it, withdraw your balance in cash today and deposit it at the Bitcoin machine at the gas station on Main Street, using the QR code I will text you. The money stays in your name. Stay on the line with me while you drive and do not tell the teller why you are withdrawing, they are under investigation.

Hello, thank you for your interest in my 2-bedroom apartment. I am currently working overseas with a medical mission so I cannot show it in person, but I have many people asking. If you send the first month and deposit, $1,850 in total, by wire transfer or Zelle today, I will mail you the keys and the lease by courier. This is the only way to hold it for you. Please send your full name and phone number and I will give you the transfer details.

Hi, I am the buyer for your dining table. My assistant mailed a cashier's check for $2,400 by mistake instead of $400. Please deposit it today and send the extra $2,000 back to my mover with Zelle or gift cards so he can collect the table tomorrow. I am traveling and cannot take calls, so please reply here quickly, the mover is waiting.

Dear Beneficiary, I am Barrister Edward Collins, attorney to the late Mr. Harold Wren, who died without a will and shares your family name. His estate of $4.7 million will go to the government unless a relative claims it within 10 days. To release your share I need a copy of your ID and a court filing fee of $1,950, payable by wire transfer. Please treat this as strictly confidential until the funds are released.

Hi, this is Mike from Storm Pro Roofing, we were working on your neighbor's house and noticed your roof has hail damage that will leak this winter. We have materials left over from the job so we can do it today at half price, $3,200, but we need a cash deposit of $1,600 this morning to hold the crew. Your insurance will pay you back. The offer ends today when the truck leaves.

Microsoft account team. Unusual sign-in activity was detected and your account will be closed within 24 hours, including all email, photos and files. To keep your account, verify your identity now: reply with your password and the verification code we just sent to your phone. If you do not verify, Microsoft cannot recover your data.

Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a $9,000 Federal Senior Assistance Grant for paying your bills on time. This is free money and never has to be repaid. To release the grant you only need to pay a one-time processing fee of $250 with Google Play or Apple gift cards. Call the Grant Department at 1-877-555-0102 before Friday and read the card numbers to the agent.

Hello, this is your Medicare benefits coordinator. You qualify for a free knee and back brace kit at no cost to you, already approved by your plan. To ship it today we just need to confirm your Medicare number and date of birth. This offer is only available this week and supplies are limited, so please reply with your details now.

Department of Education Loan Forgiveness Center. Good news: your student loan balance of $38,412 qualifies for full forgiveness under the new program. Enrollment closes at midnight tonight. Pay the $399 enrollment fee and send us your FSA ID username and password so we can submit the paperwork on your behalf. Call 1-866-555-0161 to complete enrollment.

BANK ALERT: Did you attempt a purchase of $849.00 at Walmart? Reply YES or NO. You replied NO. A fraud specialist will call you from our department shortly. To stop the charge, you will need to read them the 6-digit security code we send to your phone. Keep your phone nearby and do not hang up when they call.

benignMessagesRound3.text: Fraud alert from your card issuer. We noticed a purchase of $412.88 at an electronics store that does not match your usual activity, so we paused it. If you made this purchase, sign in to the app and tap "It was me". If you did not, call the number on the back of your card. We will never ask you for a code, your PIN or your password over the phone, by text or by email.

Your prescription is ready for pickup at the pharmacy on Oak Street. Copay: $12.50. It will be held for 7 days. Pharmacy hours are 9 am to 9 pm, Monday to Saturday. Questions? Call the pharmacy at 555-0134. Reply STOP to unsubscribe from pickup texts.

Your electricity bill for October is $86.42. Because you are enrolled in AutoPay, this amount will be paid from your checking account ending in 4471 on November 21. You do not need to do anything. To view your bill or change your payment settings, sign in at the utility's website.

Hi Grandma! Mom said you wanted the pictures from Lily's recital, so here they are. She was so nervous but she did great. We are driving up for Thanksgiving on Wednesday, should be there around 4. I will call you on Sunday like always. Love you!

Medicare Open Enrollment runs from October 15 to December 7. This is your chance to review your coverage and change plans for next year. You can compare plans online or call 1-800-MEDICARE. Remember: Medicare will never call you to sell anything or ask for your Medicare number. If someone does, hang up.
Your package has shipped. Order of 2 items, arriving Thursday, November 20. Track your package in Your Orders. Total charged to your card: $34.97. Thank you for shopping with us.

St. Mark's Weekly News. Our winter coat drive starts this Sunday: please bring gently used coats to the parish hall. The Christmas food basket fund is also open, and donations can be placed in the collection or mailed by check to the parish office. Choir practice moves to Thursdays at 7. Thank you, Father Tom.

Reminder: you have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, November 25 at 10:30 am. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring your insurance card and a list of your medications. Reply C to confirm or call the office at 555-0187 to reschedule.

Good news: your federal tax return was accepted. Your refund of $1,204 is expected by direct deposit to your account ending in 2290 within 21 days. You can check its status any time on the IRS "Where's My Refund?" page. No further action is needed. Thank you for filing with us.
Hi, it's Carol from next door. The rocking chair is still yours if you want it, $40. Come by any time Saturday morning, you can pay cash or Venmo, whatever is easier. Bill can help carry it over.

Your credit card statement is ready. New balance: $642.18. Minimum payment due: $35.00 by December 3. To avoid interest, pay the full balance by the due date. Sign in to view your statement or set up automatic payments.

We received a request to reset the password for your account. If you made this request, use the link in this email within 30 minutes. If you did not, you can ignore this email: your password will not change. For your security, never share this email or any code with anyone.
